metadata.question: Does the water surface area of Lake Tuz in Turkey decrease in August 2016 compared to August 1988?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Landsat Collection 2 Level-2: LT05 for Aug 1988 and LC08 for Aug 2016 over Lake Tuz, Turkey.
- ROI: rectangle around Lake Tuz (approx 32.9–33.7 E, 38.6–39.2 N).
- If collection empty: widen dates to Jul 15–Sep 15; for 2016 also try LE07 fallback.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds/shadows/cirrus using QA_PIXEL bits (3, 4, 2 respectively).
- Scale SR bands using L2 scale/offset.
- Build two composites: raw (for data coverage) and cloud-masked (for water extraction).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Compute valid (cloud-free) area; if 0 while images exist => C2.
- If no images after fallback => C1.
- If any computed value is null/NaN/undefined => C3.
- Otherwise compare water areas; zero is a valid value.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo((v, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err);
        else resolve(v);
      });
    });
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const roi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([32.9, 38.6, 33.7, 39.2], null, false);

  const periods = [
    { label: '1988', start: '1988-08-01', end: '1988-09-01', widenStart: '1988-07-15', widenEnd: '1988-09-15',
      datasets: [
        { id: 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', green: 'SR_B2', swir1: 'SR_B5', name: 'LT05' }
      ]
    },
    { label: '2016', start: '2016-08-01', end: '2016-09-01', widenStart: '2016-07-15', widenEnd: '2016-09-15',
      datasets: [
        { id: 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2', green: 'SR_B3', swir1: 'SR_B6', name: 'LC08' },
        { id: 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', green: 'SR_B2', swir1: 'SR_B5', name: 'LE07' } // fallback
      ]
    }
  ];

  // Functions
  function applyScaleL2(img) {
    // Apply reflectance scaling to SR bands; keep QA bands unchanged
    const scaled = img.select('SR_B.*').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return img.addBands(scaled, null, true);
  }
  function cloudMaskL2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))      // cloud shadow
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0));     // cirrus (if present)
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }

  async function processPeriod(p) {
    let used = null;
    let usedDates = {start: p.start, end: p.end};
    let col = null;
    let size = 0;

    // Try each dataset with normal dates, then widened dates if empty
    for (let d = 0; d < p.datasets.length; d++) {
      const ds = p.datasets[d];

      // Attempt normal dates
      col = ee.ImageCollection(ds.id).filterBounds(roi).filterDate(p.start, p.end);
      size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        // Attempt widened dates
        const colW = ee.ImageCollection(ds.id).filterBounds(roi).filterDate(p.widenStart, p.widenEnd);
        const sizeW = await getInfoAsync(colW.size());
        if (sizeW === 0) {
          continue; // try next dataset
        } else {
          col = colW;
          size = sizeW;
          used = `${ds.name}(widen)`;
          usedDates = {start: p.widenStart, end: p.widenEnd};
          break;
        }
      } else {
        used = ds.name;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!used || size === 0) {
      return { status: 'C1', message: `${p.label}: no images` };
    }

    // Build composites
    const dsUsed = p.datasets.find(x => used.startsWith(x.name));
    const green = dsUsed.green;
    const swir1 = dsUsed.swir1;

    const colScaled = col.map(applyScaleL2);
    const colScaledMasked = colScaled.map(cloudMaskL2);

    const rawComp = colScaled.median();
    const maskedComp = colScaledMasked.median();

    // Data-covered area (before cloud mask)
    const dataArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().rename('area')
      .updateMask(rawComp.select(green).mask())
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('area');

    // Valid (cloud-free) area
    const validArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().rename('area')
      .updateMask(maskedComp.select(green).mask())
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('area');

    const dataAreaVal = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(dataArea));
    const validAreaVal = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(validArea));

    if (dataAreaVal === null || validAreaVal === null || isNaN(dataAreaVal) || isNaN(validAreaVal)) {
      return { status: 'C3', message: `${p.label}: invalid area` };
    }
    if (dataAreaVal <= 0) {
      return { status: 'C2', message: `${p.label}: data area 0` };
    }
    if (validAreaVal <= 0) {
      return { status: 'C2', message: `${p.label}: no valid pixels after masking` };
    }

    // MNDWI and water
    const mndwi = maskedComp.normalizedDifference([green, swir1]).rename('MNDWI');
    const waterMask = mndwi.gt(0.3);

    const waterArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().rename('area')
      .updateMask(waterMask)
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('area');

    const waterCount = waterMask.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('MNDWI');

    const validCount = maskedComp.select(green).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get(green);

    const waterAreaVal = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(waterArea));
    const waterCountVal = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(waterCount));
    const validCountVal = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(validCount));

    if (waterAreaVal === null || isNaN(waterAreaVal)) {
      return { status: 'C3', message: `${p.label}: water area invalid` };
    }

    const cloudPct = (1 - (validAreaVal / dataAreaVal)) * 100.0;

    return {
      status: 'ok',
      label: p.label,
      used,
      dateRange: usedDates,
      images: size,
      dataArea_km2: dataAreaVal / 1e6,
      validArea_km2: validAreaVal / 1e6,
      cloudPct: cloudPct,
      waterArea_km2: waterAreaVal / 1e6,
      waterCount: waterCountVal || 0,
      validCount: validCountVal || 0
    };
  }

  try {
    const res1988 = await processPeriod(periods[0]);
    const res2016 = await processPeriod(periods[1]);

    // Print concise evidence
    if (res1988.status !== 'ok') {
      console.log(`1988: ${res1988.status}`);
      console.log('C1' === res1988.status ? 'Reason: Empty Collection' :
                  'C2' === res1988.status ? 'Reason: No Valid Pixels' :
                  'C3' === res1988.status ? 'Reason: Calculation Failure' : 'Reason: Other');
      console.log('C1' === res1988.status ? 'C1' :
                  'C2' === res1988.status ? 'C2' :
                  'C3' === res1988.status ? 'C3' : 'D');
      return;
    }
    if (res2016.status !== 'ok') {
      console.log(`2016: ${res2016.status}`);
      console.log('C1' === res2016.status ? 'Reason: Empty Collection' :
                  'C2' === res2016.status ? 'Reason: No Valid Pixels' :
                  'C3' === res2016.status ? 'Reason: Calculation Failure' : 'Reason: Other');
      console.log('C1' === res2016.status ? 'C1' :
                  'C2' === res2016.status ? 'C2' :
                  'C3' === res2016.status ? 'C3' : 'D');
      return;
    }

    const f = (x) => Math.round(x * 100) / 100;

    console.log(`${res1988.label} ${res1988.used}: Images=${res1988.images}, Data_km2=${f(res1988.dataArea_km2)}, Valid_km2=${f(res1988.validArea_km2)}, Cloud%=${f(res1988.cloudPct)}`);
    console.log(`${res1988.label} Water_km2=${f(res1988.waterArea_km2)} (px:${res1988.waterCount})`);
    console.log(`${res2016.label} ${res2016.used}: Images=${res2016.images}, Data_km2=${f(res2016.dataArea_km2)}, Valid_km2=${f(res2016.validArea_km2)}, Cloud%=${f(res2016.cloudPct)}`);
    console.log(`${res2016.label} Water_km2=${f(res2016.waterArea_km2)} (px:${res2016.waterCount})`);

    const delta = res2016.waterArea_km2 - res1988.waterArea_km2;
    console.log(`Delta_km2(2016-1988)=${f(delta)}`);

    // Final Answer
    const decreased = res2016.waterArea_km2 < res1988.waterArea_km2;
    console.log(decreased ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('Error:', e && e.message ? e.message : e);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
